players.product: dimensional & materials metrology for leading-edge nodes

quarterly_data.signal: 20-F customer concentration (customers not named): Customer A accounted for 23% of total sales in 2025 (18% in 2024, 19% in 2023) and Customer B for 10% (14% in 2024, 18% in 2023). The five largest customers together accounted for 51% of total revenues in 2025 (53% in 2024, 52% in 2023), each between 6-23% in 2025. Nova says its customer base is highly concentrated among a limited number of large customers, located mainly in Taiwan, Japan, South Korea, China and the United States, and that it sells substantially all of its products directly to semiconductor manufacturers.
quarterly_data.figure: Customer A 23% and Customer B 10% of 2025 sales; five largest customers 51% of 2025 revenues (range 6-23%)

quarterly_data.signal: 20-F revenue by product line (XBRL, as filed): Products revenue $705.6M in fiscal 2025, +31.1% YoY vs $538.4M; Services revenue $175.0M, +30.5% YoY vs $134.0M. Product sales were 80% of total revenues in 2025. Nova states that over the five years 2020-2025 it achieved a compound annual growth rate of products revenues of approximately 27.5%, and that 2025 brought record sales of each product line (optical integrated and stand-alone systems, materials metrology and chemical metrology systems).
quarterly_data.figure: Products $705.6M (+31.1% YoY), Services $175.0M (+30.5% YoY) in 2025; products revenue CAGR approximately 27.5% over 2020-2025

quarterly_data.signal: 20-F: as of December 31, 2025 remaining performance obligations were $93,087 thousand (comprised of $72,412 thousand deferred revenues and $20,675 thousand of uncollected amounts not yet recognized as revenues), substantially all expected to be recognized over the next year. Nova is obligated under certain agreements with its suppliers to purchase specified items of inventory expected to be utilized during 2026-2028; non-cancelable purchase obligations were approximately $152,965 thousand as of December 31, 2025. Nova includes in backlog only orders with a specified delivery date and schedules production on order backlog and customer forecasts.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO $93,087 thousand; inventory purchase obligations approximately $152,965 thousand (utilized 2026-2028)

quarterly_data.signal: 20-F capex: in 2025 gross investment in capital expenditures, including inventory items moved to capital and investment in the new ERP, was approximately $33 million, financed from operating cash flow; for 2026 Nova expects gross capital spending to remain at a similar level, primarily driven by ongoing investments in facilities and infrastructure. Production (assembly, integration, final testing and calibration) is conducted in Israel, Germany and California, and a 2026 plan is to grow production facilities and offices footprint to meet semiconductor demand.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 gross capex approximately $33 million; 2026 expected at a similar level
